title: Wiggles & Giggles
description: Wiggles & Giggles Wiggles and Giggles Storytime @ Lumpkin Lumpkin County Library Branch Tuesdays from 11:00 - 11:45 am Get ready to wiggle, giggle, and grow! This program is designed for toddlers who are confident walkers–35 months , along with their parent(s) or caregiver(s). We’ll build early literacy skills through songs, action rhymes, books, movement, and play. It’s a wonderful opportunity for toddlers to explore, hear lots of language, and have fun while connecting with their caregivers and other little ones! Wiggle & Giggles will be held Tuesdays from 11–11:45 am. Wiggles & Giggles Set
